name: Jan Jaka Jan
source:
Akira runs away from Yakuza and bumps in a young passerby girl. Trying to get rid of the pursue, he masquerades himself as the girl's boyfriend, but instead he gets her involved into the trouble. Successful to escape by himself alone, he witnesses the girl being kidnapped. Unwilling to help her, he leaves the town and forgets about the incident.

Two years later, he is back in that town; but shortly after having arrived, he is attacked on the street, and robbed of all his possessions. Now he has to get to the bottom of the mystery, but first he needs money. Since the town is big on mahjong tournaments, the hero decides to get his money back by playing that game, at the same time investigating the townspeople... in more than one way.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/fmtowns/jan-jaka-jan]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
阿基拉逃离黑帮并撞见了一名年轻的路人女孩。为了摆脱追捕，他假扮成女孩的男朋友，却把她卷入了麻烦之中。他独自成功逃脱，却亲眼目睹了女孩被绑架。他不愿意帮助她，于是离开了小镇，忘记了这件事。

两年后，他又回到了那个小镇；但抵达后不久，他在街上遭到袭击，所有财产被抢走。现在他必须弄清楚这个谜团的真相，但首先他需要钱。由于该镇盛行麻将锦标赛，英雄决定通过玩麻将游戏来拿回自己的钱，同时以不止一种方式调查镇上的人们。
